description: Use this when the user asks to delete a formula, version, material, bottle, batch or note. It is step 1 of 2 and deletes NOTHING: it shows exactly what would be removed, with any protection, and returns a confirmation token valid for 10 minutes. Show the list to the user; only after they agree, call confirm_delete. Locked formulas cannot be deleted here.
name: delete_items
title: Prepare a deletion (step 1 of 2)
